name: Super Treehouse Tycoon
seoDescription: Discover Super Treehouse Tycoon codes that grant Honey and Capture Points to build and upgrade your treehouse faster in this forest adventure game.
introMd: Super Treehouse Tycoon lets you build and customize your own treehouse while exploring a forest full of resources. Codes in the game give you extra Honey or Capture Points, which help you upgrade your treehouse and progress faster. Using Super Treehouse Tycoon codes is a smart way to get a boost without waiting too long, especially when you want to expand your treehouse quickly or try new pets.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Super Treehouse Tycoon Codes
There are no special requirements to redeem codes. Just follow these simple steps to get your rewards.
1. [[roblox_link|Launch Super Treehouse Tycoon]].
2. Look for the CODES button on the right side of the screen and click it.
3. Type the code exactly as it appears, since codes are case sensitive.
4. Press ENTER to claim your reward.
5. Check your inventory or currency to see the added Honey or Capture Points.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Codes in Super Treehouse Tycoon mostly give you Honey or Capture Points, both crucial for building and upgrading.

| Reward Type       | Description                                      |
|-------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| Honey             | The main currency used to buy building materials and upgrades for your treehouse. |
| Capture Points    | Points used to catch pets and unlock special features in the game.                |
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes might fail if you do not enter them exactly as shown because they are case sensitive. Double-check for any typos or extra spaces before or after the code. Also, some codes expire, so if a code doesn’t work, it might no longer be active.
findCodesMd:
## Where to Find New Super Treehouse Tycoon Codes
New codes for Super Treehouse Tycoon usually drop through the developer’s official Discord, especially in the #codes channel. The developer updates codes occasionally, so checking there often helps. You can also find announcements on the developer’s social media accounts listed below.
